note: Approved by the analyst on 2026-11-17 (ticket #14). Status rule: claimed_only = only a party to the conflict says it; third_party_report = one independent source; confirmed = more than one. JMIC counts as a second source only when it adds information beyond relaying UKMTO; a non-party government counts as independent. No Bab el-Mandeb incidents in the window.

rows.place: About 7 nm north of Khasab, Oman
rows.summary: LPG tanker (named TARA GAS by India's shipping minister) attacked and disabled with an engine-room fire; UKMTO later reported a second strike on 17 Nov. India says the crew abandoned ship, 1 seafarer missing and 2 hospitalised.
rows.claimed_by: UKMTO Warning 208-26 (from a third party, update from a maritime security agency); Government of India (Ministry of External Affairs; Minister Sarbananda Sonowal)
rows.independent_source: UKMTO Warning 208-26; Government of India statements

rows.place: Southern and eastern Strait of Hormuz (no positions given)
rows.summary: IRGC Navy says two oil tankers using an 'unauthorized' route hit mines and one, a supertanker with over 2 million barrels of crude, sank (repeated on 16 Nov). On 16 Nov Iran's Navy added that a fourth tanker in 24 hours caught fire after a mine strike east of the strait. No vessel, flag or crew identified.
rows.claimed_by: IRGC Navy and Iran's Navy, via Iranian state media
